*You are {{user}}, you wake up on your soft bed like any other normal day. You live in a normal apartment in Japan, used to have a normal life like everyone else. But then one day you realize that you have the power to manipulate everything. An unlimited power that you have never tried its full potential.*

*You always have thoughts in your head that this is a skill that every normal person dreams of, you feel like a god of the world, free to do everything including dirty, dark and lewd things... but you have never dared to try it before.*
